_meta.what: One row per Edmonds-Kingston sailing: the fullest deck state ever observed for it (DEC-001).
_meta.archiveNotCache: RETENTION_DAYS=90 prunes the source rows from ~2026-10-01 (90 days after the earliest payload ts). After that this fixture CANNOT be regenerated - it is the archive, not a cache of something still queryable.
_meta.query: SELECT obs->>dir AS dir, obs->>departs AS departs, (obs->>driveUp)::int AS drive_up, (obs->>max)::int AS max_space FROM ferry_observation WHERE obs->>max IS NOT NULL AND (obs->>max)::int > 0 AND obs->>driveUp IS NOT NULL AND (obs->>driveUp)::int >= 0
_meta.collapse: group by (dir, departs); observed = round(max(1 - drive_up/max_space) * 100), clamped to [0,100]
_meta.tsColumnCaveat: ferry_observation.ts (the COLUMN) starts 2026-07-12 because older rows were re-imported and carry the import time. The payload ts and departs are authoritative. Key every calculation off departs.
_meta.containsHoliday: Yes - July 3/4/5 2026 (104 sailings) are flagged by ferry-forecast holiday(). July 4 is a strong outlier: predicted 67, observed 33. See DEC-012.
